$why: An agent that writes code or tests may use only what the codeline declares. A package present on disk and not
declared builds locally and fails for every consumer; an agent asked for a capability that needs one has to be
told the declaration, or it will reach for whatever happens to be installed.
A fragment composed into an agent's prompt: no seam declares it, so it renders from the engine layer.
description: Tells an agent which packages the codeline declares, and that it may use only those.
body:
## PACKAGES THIS CODELINE DECLARES
```json
__DECLARED_PACKAGES__
```
Use only packages listed in `declared` (when `manifestRead` is false, none is known to be declared). A package present on disk but not listed is not available: never import it, and never add a dependency. If what you were asked needs a package that is not declared, say so in your final message instead of working around it.
